name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana
benefit:
- A monthly pension amount of ₹500/- (Rupees 500) is provided.
- The benefit is provided monthly.
- The funds are deposited into the joint savings account of the applicant couple or the single applicant's account maintained at a nationalized bank or Post Office.

_*The beneficiary must continue to fulfill the established eligibility criteria as defined in the rules so that the benefits are not
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradeah. - The applicant couple or the single applicant must have a minimum age of 60 years for at least one person at the time of application. - The applicant couple or the single applicant must have only daughters. - The applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line category.
